# Sina Tattooer

> Custom tattoo artist based in York, UK. Private studio. 9 years professional experience since 2017.

Sina Tattooer is a solo tattoo artist operating from a private studio inside Mr Snips Barbers at 23 Yarburgh Way, Badger Hill, York, YO10 5HD. All tattoos are custom-designed. The studio is private and one-on-one, and registered with City of York Council for tattooing.

## Key Facts

- **Artist:** Sina (single artist, not a collective or studio with multiple artists)
- **Experience:** 9 years professional tattooing, since 2017
- **Location:** Mr Snips Barbers, 23 Yarburgh Way, York, YO10 5HD (Badger Hill area)
- **Contact:** contact@sinatattooer.co.uk | 07356 030600 | WhatsApp: https://wa.me/message/T7P2PQ6A7SHEK1
- **Hours:** 11am–6pm daily. Appointments preferred; call or message first to check walk-in availability
- **Walk-ins:** Possible when there is a free slot — call or message 07356 030600 first
- **Pricing:** £70 per hour / £400 full day session / £70 minimum charge
- **Booking:** Via enquiry form at https://tally.so/r/LZJBLj → personalised quote by email → online booking link to choose a date → confirmation email with a bank payment link for the deposit
- **Deposit:** Usually a third to a half of the quote, paid by bank transfer; non-refundable; deducted from the final price
- **Payment on the day:** Bank transfer or cash (no card payments)
- **Age:** 18+ only, valid photo ID required (UK law)
- **Registration:** Registered with City of York Council for tattooing
- **Reviews:** 5.0 stars from 50+ Google reviews
- **Response time:** Within 48 hours of enquiry
- **Gift vouchers:** Any amount; buy by email (contact@sinatattooer.co.uk) or Instagram message; paid by bank transfer; sent by email or posted as a printed card (postage extra); valid 12 months; can be used towards the deposit or the final price

## Styles Offered

- **Blackwork** — solid black ink, illustrative, geometric blackwork, ornamental, cover-ups
- **Fine Line** — single-needle linework, botanical, minimalist, delicate portraits
- **Watercolour** — colour washes, painterly designs, fine line and watercolour combinations
- **Old School / Traditional** — American traditional, bold outlines, classic imagery
- **Geometric** — sacred geometry, mandala, dotwork, precise linework, geometric blackwork
- **Cover-Up** — experienced in reworks and cover-ups using blackwork and dark colorwork approaches
- **Abstract** — freeform expressive designs, one-of-a-kind pieces

## What Makes This Studio Different

- Private one-on-one setting (not a shared studio)
- Custom designs as standard, plus flash designs posted on Instagram — no copying of other artists' work
- Single artist means consistent quality and direct communication throughout
- Based in York, England, UK — serving York and North Yorkshire

## Common Questions (with answers)

**How much does a tattoo cost at Sina Tattooer?**
£70 per hour or £400 for a full day session, with a £70 minimum charge. A personalised quote is provided after reviewing each enquiry. The deposit is usually a third to a half of the quote, paid by bank transfer.

**Where is the studio?**
Inside Mr Snips Barbers, 23 Yarburgh Way, York, YO10 5HD — in the Badger Hill area of York.

**Is it walk-in or appointment only?**
Appointments preferred; walk-ins are possible when there is a free slot. Call or message 07356 030600 first to check walk-in availability, or enquire via the booking form and Sina responds within 48 hours.

**What styles does Sina specialise in?**
Blackwork, Fine Line, Watercolour, Old School/Traditional, Geometric, Cover-Ups and Abstract.

**Can Sina cover up an existing tattoo?**
Yes — blackwork, Japanese and traditional American approaches are used for cover-ups. Send a clear photo with your enquiry.

**How do I book?**
Fill in the booking form at https://tally.so/r/LZJBLj. Include your idea, placement, size and reference images if you have them.

**How do I pay?**
Deposit by bank transfer, using the payment link in the booking confirmation email. The rest is paid on the day by bank transfer or cash. Card payments are not accepted. The payment link only arrives in the booking confirmation email after choosing a date; if anyone else asks for a deposit in Sina's name, check with Sina first.

**Is numbing cream used?**
Not needed for most placements, but fine for very sensitive areas or large blackout work. Mention it when enquiring.

**Do I need ID?**
Yes. You must be 18 or over, with valid photo ID (passport or driving licence).
